title: Substrate library
description: Substrates available to a fitting job, keyed by id. A job names one id; the preset names the default. Material names are resolved against whatever Henke table the operator's engine was built with, which is extensible: a name absent from the shipped table is not an error, it means the operator supplies that table entry.

substrates.description: Keyed by substrate id, e.g. "si", "soda-lime-glass". The id is what a job passes.

material.description: Henke table name. May be an entry the operator added to their own table.

density.description: g/cm3. Held fixed: the engine does not fit the substrate.

sigma_A.description: Default roughness in Angstrom. Polish- and supplier-dependent, so it is a starting value for this laboratory's stock, not a property of the material.

provenance.description: Where the density and sigma come from. A value that was never measured must say so.

requires_table_entry.description: True when `material` is not in the stock Henke table and the operator must add it. `table_entry_hint` then says how.

table_entry_hint.description: Composition or formula sufficient to generate the table entry.
